constraints: CentOS Linux has no upgrade path to CentOS Stream; plan a rebuild or a migration to another distribution.
Confirm application packages and repositories exist for the target platform before rebuilding.

steps.instructions: Rebuild the host on CentOS Stream or a distribution with a published lifecycle, then redeploy the workload.
steps.title: Replace the CentOS host

verification.purpose: Confirm the host reports the target CentOS release.
Check that package updates resolve on the target release.

rule.replacement: CentOS Stream 9 or 10, or a distribution with a published lifecycle
rule.summary: CentOS Linux 8 reached end of life on 2021-12-31 and CentOS Linux 7 on 2024-06-30, so neither receives fixes. CentOS Stream 9 and 10 follow a different lifecycle and are not covered by this rule.
rule.title: CentOS Linux 8 and older are end-of-life
